answer: Each identity anchors its standing to one glacier: a slow mass of verified work that only grows forward, one epoch at a time, and cannot be rushed or bought. Every new claim must pass a crystal check, a transparent test anyone can recompute, proving the claim's anchor history matches its own past jobs. A fake with no glacier fails at once, and a farm cannot shortcut the ice. Ten fakes therefore owe ten separate glaciers, ten crystal checks, and ten anchor histories, and no glacier, crystal, or anchor can be pooled or reused across clones.
